Compute Match — Backend API Reference (Summary)
Interactive documentation runs at http://localhost:8082/docs locally. A snapshot is in backend/openapi.json (it omits Access Request and internal routes). Routers are in backend/infrastructure/driving/http/routers/ and are mounted in main.py. All business APIs are under /api/v1 (one v2 endpoint).
Public
Method Path Purpose GET /health Liveness check, no auth
Customers APIs
Method Path Purpose Scope POST /api/v1/reservation-request Create a reservation or custom request create_reservation_request GET /api/v1/customer/reservation-requests List my requests requester_view_reservation_request GET /api/v1/customer/reservation-request/{id} Request detail same POST /api/v1/reservation-request/{id}/cancel Cancel requester_manage_reservation_request POST /api/v1/reservation-request/{id}/offering/{oid}/extend-acceptance-expiry Extend acceptance window accept_contract_extension POST /api/v1/reservation-request/{id}/offering/{oid}/extend-contract-expiry Extend contract window accept_contract_extension GET /api/v1/gpu-offerings Browse offerings view_capacity GET /api/v1/gpu-offerings/availability Availability view_capacity GET /api/v1/gpu-offerings/capacity-overview Capacity overview view_capacity GET /api/v2/gpu-offerings/availability-by-filters Filtered availability view_capacity GET /api/v1/organizations/suggest Organization name suggestions authenticated
Providers APIs (NCP and admin)
Method Path Purpose Scope GET /api/v1/provider/reservation-requests List requests for my NCP (all for admins) approver_view_reservation_request GET /api/v1/provider/reservation-request/{id} Detail same POST /api/v1/provider/offering/{id}/accept Accept offering approver_manage_reservation_request POST /api/v1/provider/offering/{id}/reject Reject (remarks required) same POST /api/v1/provider/offering/{id}/contract Confirm contract same POST /api/v1/provider/offering/{id}/resend-magic-link Resend magic link provider/admin GET /api/v1/provider/custom-demand-requests List custom requests approver_view_custom_reservation_request (status update) custom demand transition endpoints In Review / Matched / Unserviceable approver_manage_custom_reservation_request GET /api/v1/provider/gpu-offerings My inventory view_provider_inventory POST /api/v1/provider/gpu-offerings/import Upload capacity CSV (202) manage_inventory GET /api/v1/provider/gpu-offerings/import/history Upload history manage_inventory / admin POST /api/v1/provider/gpu-offerings/import/{id}/approve Accept future capacity review_capacity POST /api/v1/provider/gpu-offerings/import/{id}/reject Reject future capacity review_capacity POST /api/v1/provider/onboard-providers Bulk onboard NCPs (CSV) manage_ncp GET /api/v1/provider/global-capacity-map Global capacity global_capacity_view
Access Request APIs (only when NPN integration is enabled, otherwise 404)
Method Path Scope GET /api/v1/provider/access-requests manage_ncp GET /api/v1/provider/access-requests/{id} manage_ncp POST /api/v1/provider/access-requests/{id}/approve manage_ncp POST /api/v1/provider/access-requests/{id}/reject manage_ncp
Inventory APIs (reference data)
Countries, geographical regions, GPU models, hosting providers, interconnect types, regions — read with view_capacity; create geographical region or GPU model with manage_inventory.
Users APIs
Method Path Purpose POST /api/v1/user Provision the signed-in user from JWT claims (organization, partner domain checks; may create an access request) GET /api/v1/user Current user POST /api/v1/users/me/terms-acceptance Record Terms and Conditions acceptance POST /api/v1/auth/logout Logout
Operations APIs (role operations)
Activate user, list users, resend activation magic link, delete user.
Feedback APIs
Submit feedback, check eligibility (/api/v1/feedback/eligibility), record prompt state (/api/v1/feedback/prompt). Feedback kinds: POST_TASK, GENERAL, CANCELLATION, DROP_OFF. Journeys: capacity_upload, reservation_request, app_general. Categories: suggest_feature, report_problem, general. Prompt states: SHOWN, SUBMITTED, SKIPPED, DISMISSED.
System APIs (Temporal worker service account)
Group Scope /api/v1/notification/* (all emails, reminders, magic links) notification:send /api/v1/multi-provider/expire-acceptance, /expire-contract notification:send /api/v1/reservation-request/expire reservation-request:write /api/v1/offering/validate-nonce Keycloak extension /api/v1/system/csv-import/*, /api/v1/system/provider-onboarding/process capacity:sync
Internal APIs (hidden from schema)
POST /api/v1/internal/salesforce/offtake-sync, /notify-failure, /partner-domain-sync — caller client_id must equal SFDC_SYNC_CALLER_CLIENT_ID.
POST /api/v1/internal/audit/keycloak-event — Keycloak audit listener ingest.
Cross-cutting behaviour
JWT validation against Keycloak; permissions from scope, realm_access.roles and resource_access.*.roles claims.
Middleware blocks users who are PENDING or have not accepted terms (with an allowlist for the endpoints needed to finish setup).
Request body limit 15 MB; CSV upload limit 10 MB.
Redis-backed rate limiting per bucket.
